description:
Track all your AI coding subscription usage from the Windows system tray.

OpenTokenUsage is a lightweight system-tray app that tracks how much of your AI coding subscriptions you've used (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, and more) in one place. It is a Windows fork of OpenUsage with full Windows support, a plugin-based provider system, and a local HTTP usage API.
Usage notifications come once per window again.
Bug Fixes
- Notifications: past 80% the same "at 80%" alert kept coming back, and a "has reset" alert came although nothing had reset. Claude reports its reset time a few milliseconds differently on every refresh, and each new time counted as a new window; reset times less than an hour apart now count as the same window, for every provider
